mechanism: Meloxicam (NSAID) may inhibit praziquantel metabolism via CYP3A4 inhibition and increase bleeding risk, while praziquantel may induce CYP3A4 affecting meloxicam clearance.
action: Monitor for increased meloxicam side effects and praziquantel efficacy; consider alternative antiparasitic or NSAID if possible; ensure adequate renal function monitoring.
